<quote by="Proposed: Sermersuaq, Seconded: Madruga">The Beacons of Wintermark <u>must</u> be completed. We shall construct the final set within Sermersuaq. As part of this commission we call upon a boon provided by Cathan Canae in recognition of our resilience against two armies of Oblivion.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Sealtoq, Sermersuaq
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Farm,_fur,_and_fish#Extraneous_Castles|Farm, fur, and fish]]''' and '''[[Tales_of_imagination#Wolves_and_Bears_(Cathan_Canae)|Tales of imagination]]''' winds of fortunes

==Date==
* Winter 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 30 wains of white granite
* 25 wains of weirwood
* 165 crowns in labour costs
* Six months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Beacon_of_Sermersuaq}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the Beacons of Sermersuaq have the following effects:
* [[military unit|Military units]] are able to [[Military_unit#Guarding|guard]] the beacons of [[Sermersuaq]]
* [[Cathan Canae]] will send the ritual text of ''Drums of the Iron Harpoon'' to the [[Narwhal's Spear|General of the Narwhal's Spear]] at the Summer Solstice 388YE
